commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Robin Zentner easily deals with the threat.
90+2' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) sees a yellow card from Sascha Stegemann after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' Here's the change. Nadiem Amiri leaves the pitch and Lennard Maloney (Mainz) comes on as a substitute.

87' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Anthony Caci is replaced by Silvan Widmer (Mainz).
85' Substitution. Nathan Ngoumou walks off the pitch and Noah Pesch (B. Monchengladbach) comes on as a substitute.
85' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
82' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.

77' 1 - 3 Brilliant finish! Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Jae-Sung Lee, then produced a nice strike into the right side of the goal. The score is 1:3.

63' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 54:46.
60' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Robin Zentner.
59' Great save! Paul Nebel (Mainz) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Jonas Omlin.

58' Moritz Jenz (Mainz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to B. Monchengladbach in a dangerous position.
56' Substitution. Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) has come on for Kevin Stoger.
55' B. Monchengladbach seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
52' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
51' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Mainz.
49' 0 - 2 Goal! Dominik Kohr (Mainz) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:2.

48' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His header would have probably ended up in the middle of the goal, but Jonas Omlin pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
48' It seemed like Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Sascha Stegemann has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Paul Nebel (Mainz) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' A pass by Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
41' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
39' 0 - 1 Goal! Paul Nebel (Mainz) takes a short pass from Jae-Sung Lee in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
37' B. Monchengladbach enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
36' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) causes Jonas Omlin little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
31' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.

30' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
27' The linesman points to the corner flag, B. Monchengladbach are going to take it.

26' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) jumps above the defenders in order to convert a lofted cross with a nice header. Robin Zentner makes a reflexive save to block his effort from hitting the net.
25' The percentage of ball possession is – 56:44.

20' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
18' Paul Nebel (Mainz) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
17' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
13' The B. Monchengladbach players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
9' The linesman signals that Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
